RA-Q1.question: What is Mom doing in the kitchen?
RA-Q1.openness: 动作细节·原文直接提取（第一段）
accepted_answers: cooking dinner and washing some vegetables
she is cooking dinner and washing vegetables
RA-Q1.required_grammar: 现在进行时 be+V-ing（G46）：canonical 为现在分词短语省略 be，完整句变体 she is cooking...（G46）；cook→cooking、wash→washing 直接加 ing（G47）
